profile.ja:
高位の魔族・蛇神ナーガ族の３人の族長の一人。
猛毒を操る。
暗殺卿ケーレスを名乗り、魔界の夜と闇を支配する領土なき支配者。
長く生きていて、対魔忍・相州蛇子の先祖にあたる。
ナーガ族の族長の残り二人は『タクシャカ』と『カリヤ』である。
profile.en: She is one of the three chiefs of the Naga tribe, a high-ranking demon and snake god. She manipulates deadly poison. She is known as the Duke of Assassins, Keres, and is a lord without territory who rules over the night and darkness of the Demon Realm. She has lived for a long time and is an ancestor of the Taimanin, Aishu Hebiko. The other two chiefs of the Naga tribe are Takshaka and Kaliya.

text.ja: ここでは、ヴァースキと名乗るべきだろうな。曾孫、蛇子のあい――おっと……信頼する隊長殿の器量、たしかめさせてもらうとしよう
text.en: I suppose I should introduce myself as Vasuki here. My great-grandchild, and Hebiko's... ah, I see - I'll have you gauge the captain's worth, if you will.

text.ja: あの子は私の名前を継いでいるわけだからな……君があの子を蛇子と呼ぶたび、どうも背中がムズムズしてくるよ
text.en: That child is taking on my name, after all... every time you call her Hebiko, it makes my back tingle for some reason.

text.ja: こういう話をするのは、ガラでもないが……いつも蛇子が世話になっているね。これからも仲良くしてやっておくれ
text.en: I'm not one for idle chatter, but... Hebiko's always getting taken care of, is she? I hope you'll get along with her from now on.

text.ja: どうしたのかな、そんなにマジマジと見つめて。私の顔が好みだったのか？　それは重畳……あの子も、私に似てくるだろうからね
text.en: What's wrong, staring at me like that? Do you have a thing for my face or something? That's quite flattering... and I suppose Hebiko will grow up to look like me too.

text.ja: 普段、蛇子とはどんな接し方をしている？　ほう……なるほど……ふむ……足りないのはスキンシップだな……それとなく、伝えておくか
text.en: How do you usually interact with Hebiko, then? I see... I suppose what's missing is some skinship. I'll have to convey that to her somehow.

text.ja: 流石に相州家に居座るのは、気を遣わせるからな。地上には、別の拠点を置いている。いつでも遊びにくるといい
text.en: I suppose it's a bit much to ask to stay at the Aishu estate, so I've set up a different base on the surface. Feel free to visit anytime.

text.ja: そういえば――昨日、町で君を見たぞ。蛇子ではない女子と歩いていたな……蛇子とも、出かけることはあるか？　そうか、ならばよい
text.en: By the way, I saw you in town yesterday. You were walking with a girl who wasn't Hebiko... do you ever go out with Hebiko? Ah, I see - that's good to hear.

text.ja: しかし、地上もずいぶんと変わった……。悪い部分もあるが……それ以上に、よい変化を感じているのだ
text.en: The surface world has changed quite a bit, hasn't it? There's some bad, but... I sense more good changes than that.

text.ja: 君の器量をたしかめると言っただろう。当然、こちらのほうもだ……ほう、なかなかのデカマラだな。これは楽しめそうだ……♪
text.en: I said I'd gauge your worth, and naturally, you'll do the same for me... ah, you've got quite a package, don't you? This should be fun...

text.ja: んむぅ……ぐぷぅ、じゅぼぉ……んっは、牡臭いな……あむぅぅ……じゅぶっ、じゅるぅぅ……私好みの、チンポの味をしている……♪
text.en: Mmm... gulp, juuub... nngh, you smell like a man... amuu, juub, jiruu... you've got the taste of a cock I like...

text.ja: んんんぅっ、はぁっ、あっ、あぁぁぁ……久方ぶりのぉ、まぐわいっ……んんぅぅっ！　はぁっ、あっ、たまらんっ……あはぁっっ♪
text.en: Nnnnng, haa, ah, ahhh... it's been a while since I've had a good fuck... nnnnng! Haa, ah, it's unbearable... ahhhh...
